### Airport shuttles

Arrival and departure shuttles between the airports and Angera / JRC Ispra are being
organised. Details to be confirmed.

| Airport | Direction | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Milano Malpensa (MXP) | Airport → Angera / JRC Ispra | to be confirmed | closest airport to JRC Ispra |
| Milano Malpensa (MXP) | Angera / JRC Ispra → Airport | to be confirmed | |
| Milano Linate (LIN) | both directions | to be confirmed | |

Participants are asked to share their arrival and departure times with the workshop
coordination so that shuttle capacity can be planned.

### Access to the JRC site

The JRC Ispra site is an access-controlled facility. Bring a valid photo ID (passport
or national identity card) matching the name used at registration. Allow extra time for
the entrance check, in particular on Day 2 (08:30–09:00).
